content.comment_body: Hello Experts, I developed a program to display certain values both on [product_name] and its operator panel. The values include the remaining time for an On-Delay timer and Sunrise/Sunset times from the astronomical clock. While everything appears correctly on the [product_name] screen, the operator panel does not show the Sunrise and Sunset times. Does anyone know why this might be happening? Thanks for your help. Update: I tried using other blocks (such as stopwatch, available only in [product_name] [article_no]) but the operator panel still does not display anything.
Hello, Did you enable the 'use new feature' option in the message text settings under the File menu? Regards,
Yes, I've set that as default. I'm beginning to think there might be a mismatch between the firmware versions of [product_name] [article_no] and its operator panel.
Have you checked the box in the message text properties to ensure that the message will be displayed on both [product_name] and its operator panel?

Hello, There are different firmware versions for the operator panel: ES6 is fully compatible with [article_no] 0BA6 and ES7 is fully compatible with [article_no] 0BA7. The operator panel with ES6 firmware works with [product_name] [article_no] 0BA7, but only parameters up to block number 200 can be displayed, and only values and parameters compatible with the 0BA6 version are shown. To display values from the astronomical clock block, you need an operator panel with the latest firmware. Sorry... Best regards, [user_name]
Thank you all for your responses.

analysis.insight_summary: Users observed that the main device successfully shows On-Delay timer values and astronomical clock outputs (such as Sunrise and Sunset times), while the connected operator panel does not display the astronomical clock readings, even when message settings appear correct. Community insights point to firmware compatibility issues on the operator panel, especially regarding advanced blocks introduced in newer main device versions. Firmware mismatches are suspected, and it is noted that older operator panel firmware supports limited block values and parameters from older device modules.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect that advanced feature outputs, including Sunrise and Sunset times, should display reliably on both the main control device and the operator panel, regardless of firmware version or module generation.
